shadow-dom.title: Shadow DOM
shadow-dom.description: Elements hidden inside open, nested and closed shadow roots, so you can check how your tools reach into the shadow DOM.
shadow-dom.information: Regular selectors stop at a shadow root boundary. The open shadow root can be pierced by most tools, the nested example needs two hops, the slotted content lives in the light DOM even though it is shown inside a shadow root, and the closed shadow root cannot be reached through host.shadowRoot at all.

open.description: A small form rendered inside an open shadow root.

nested.description: A counter inside a shadow root that is itself inside another shadow root.

slot.description: Light DOM content projected into a shadow root through a slot.

closed.title: Closed shadow root
closed.description: A button inside a closed shadow root. Only the result below is in the light DOM.
